title: Long Island crash near Moriches Bay
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Long Island crash near Moriches Bay, about 1989 at Moriches Bay, Long Island, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Moriches Bay, Long Island, New York

tellings.quote: the the Long Island crash, I think it was supposed to be 1989 by Morish's Bay.

plain: A UFO historian, Richard Dolan, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2025, mentions a story of a crash on Long Island, New York, near Moriches Bay, which he says was "supposed to be" in 1989. He connects it with the names John Ford and Elaine Douglas. If true, a craft of unknown origin would have come down near New York.
